Unidentified drone fragments found near Moșești in Buzău County

21 October 2026 · Moșești, Robeasca · Unidentified drone fragments

Provisional drone-fragment discovery; origin and crash date unresolved

A resident found apparent drone remains in a field outside Moșești, Robeasca commune, on 21 October 2026. The prefect described engine, fuselage and propeller fragments scattered over about 100 square metres. MApN and SRI specialists investigated.

Initial checks found no explosive elements. This is a provisional recovery record: foreign involvement, the aircraft’s identity and the crash date remain unresolved. The map uses the discovery date and an approximate village anchor.
